package.name: aav_costmap
package.description: Our own costmap in Rust (rclrs): Nav2's costmap_2d layers ported (the static map, obstacle layers that mark and ray-clear, inflation with the car's outline), a rolling local window in odom and a global one on the map. A trial beside Nav2's costmaps (navigation.launch.py costmap:=own): it publishes /drivers/nav/costmap/local and /global (OccupancyGrid, and nav2_msgs/Costmap on *_raw), and aav_mppi_lag reads its local one instead of Nav2's.
